normalized.description: The subject of this procurement is the supply of specialized municipal vehicles for waste management and public area maintenance, including waste collection and transportation vehicles of various capacities, vehicles equipped with waste compaction systems, vehicles fitted with roof-mounted cranes for emptying underground and semi-underground containers, as well as specialized vehicles for container transport and handling recyclable materials. The procurement also includes vehicles equipped with recycling cranes, roll-off trucks and skip loaders intended for the transport of different types of containers and waste streams, together with municipal sweepers of various capacities and a hot-water public surface washing vehicle. The objective of the procurement is to modernize and renew the vehicle fleet, increase the efficiency of the waste management system, improve separate waste collection, and enhance the standard of public area cleanliness and maintenance within the City of Zagreb
